Activation: 2

Cost: 2 Investiture

Two voices, one law. Many hands, one work.

Spend 2 Investiture. For the scene, your active Covenants form a Concord: an ally in a Covenant with you may, as a Free Action on its turn, grant any other Covenant ally the benefit of the Aid action, and each Covenant ally's first attack each round deals additional damage equal to your Presence.

description.value:
Activation: 1

Cost: 1 Investiture

The hands met. The promise was older than either of them.

Spend 1 Investiture and touch a willing ally; you and that ally enter a Covenant for the scene. While the Covenant holds, you and the ally each gain +1 to all defenses when within Attunement Range of each other, and may use the Aid action targeting each other at any range within Attunement Range. A Covenant ends if either party deliberately attacks the other. You may sustain up to your tier active Covenants.

description.value:
Activation: 1

Cost: 1 Investiture

He spoke the rule once. The world wrote it down.

Spend 1 Investiture and place an Edict on a character in Attunement Range, declaring one prohibited action (move from its space, attack a chosen ally, activate Investiture, etc.). The first time the bound character takes the prohibited action, it takes [Tier][Die] + Intellect spirit damage and is Disoriented until the start of your next turn; the Edict is then consumed. You may sustain up to your tier Edicts; unviolated Edicts fade at the end of the scene.

description.value:
Activation: 3

Cost: 3 Investiture

The law was not written today. It was only finally spoken.

Spend 3 Investiture and name one prohibited action that applies to every enemy in Attunement Range as if bound by your Edict; each ally in a Covenant with you is named a Witness. The first time any bound enemy takes the prohibited action, every active Edict you have immediately triggers, every Witness gains [Tier][Die] temporary HP and an advantage on its next attack test, and each enemy within 10 ft of the violator takes [Tier][Die] + Intellect spirit damage. Once per scene.

Activation: r

The bond is mutual. So is the wound.

When an ally in a Covenant with you would take damage and you are within Attunement Range, you may take half that damage instead and reduce the remaining damage to that ally by your White. Both you and that ally gain temporary HP equal to your White.
